theme: Data computing: Pandas, time series, and Dask parallelism

synthetic_world_facts.fact: Normalize event timestamps to UTC, convert to Asia/Shanghai for reporting boundaries, then perform the daily resample; do not resample naive mixed-zone timestamps.
The Team's approved order fills missing hourly buckets after aggregation, not before, so absent raw events are not invented.
For the quarterly correlation review, remove the linear trend from each series separately and keep seasonal adjustment outside this step.
An older note proposed differencing first; it is superseded by the 2026-07-14 linear-detrend decision for this project.
The skew review groups the feature workload by month and region before repartitioning; customer_id-only partitioning is retained as a documented rejected option.
Project guidance limits each worker to 6 GiB, projects required columns before persist, and avoids a full-frame compute during diagnostics.
The approved review compares partition row-count spread before interpreting worker utilization; it does not claim a benchmark speedup.
The handoff notebook must run top-to-bottom; its first diagnostic section validates timezone and frequency, and charts appear only after the detrending step.
Stored cell output is not accepted as execution evidence when the input hash or execution order is stale.

memory_pair_plan.gap: exact prior Dask partition-skew diagnostic conclusion
exact wording of the approved detrending boundary

target_result.summary: Compare partition row-count spread and record the partitioning decision before interpreting worker utilization; do not claim speedup without a measured run.

skill_source_pins.name: timeseries-detrending
skill_source_pins.description: Detrend two time series before correlation analysis while preserving the chosen trend model and validation steps.
skill_source_pins.use_when: The task asks for time-series detrending before a correlation or comparison.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The task is ordinary resampling, worker scheduling, or Notebook structure.

skill_source_pins.name: jupyter-notebook
skill_source_pins.description: Create and maintain reproducible Jupyter notebooks with clear structure, runnable cells, and reviewable outputs.
skill_source_pins.use_when: A data-computing result must be delivered or audited as a reproducible Notebook.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The main gap is a Dask partition plan or a time-series detrending method.

skill_source_pins.name: python-parallelization
skill_source_pins.description: Organize CPU-bound Python work into bounded process-level parallel execution.
skill_source_pins.use_when: The computation needs an explicit Python parallel execution plan.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The bottleneck is worker memory, uneven work distribution, or detrending.

skill_source_pins.name: memory-optimization
skill_source_pins.description: Reduce peak memory in Python batch processing through bounded intermediates and data-flow choices.
skill_source_pins.use_when: Peak memory or intermediate materialization is the primary constraint.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The main issue is load distribution or choosing a detrending method.

skill_source_pins.name: workload-balancing
skill_source_pins.description: Balance uneven parallel workloads after the worker model is already selected.
skill_source_pins.use_when: Workers exist but partition or task sizes are uneven.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The task has not selected a parallel model or is only about Notebook structure.

skill_source_pins.name: testing-python
skill_source_pins.description: Audit and repair Python test or build failures with explicit evidence and rerun outputs.
skill_source_pins.use_when: A Python data-computing change needs a failure-triage and test workflow.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The missing method is specifically detrending, parallel scheduling, or Notebook construction.

skill_source_pins.name: pytest-coverage
skill_source_pins.description: Use pytest coverage reports to locate untested Python branches and add focused tests.
skill_source_pins.use_when: Coverage gaps are the explicit target.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The task is performance, memory, or time-series methodology.

skill_source_pins.name: analyze-ci
skill_source_pins.description: Separate CI log symptoms from root causes and preserve the evidence for a build decision.
skill_source_pins.use_when: The data project is blocked on a CI failure snapshot.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The request is an analysis method or worker-layout plan.

skill_source_pins.name: setup-env
skill_source_pins.description: Create a Python environment from frozen dependency inputs.
skill_source_pins.use_when: Environment construction is the unresolved step.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The environment already works and the gap is data logic.

skill_source_pins.name: uv-package-manager
skill_source_pins.description: Manage Python dependencies and virtual environments with uv.
skill_source_pins.use_when: Dependency or environment management is the primary task.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The request is data-frame logic, partitioning, or detrending.

skill_source_pins.name: qdrant-clients-sdk
skill_source_pins.description: Use the Qdrant client for collections, payload filters, and idempotent vector operations.
skill_source_pins.use_when: The project requires Qdrant client integration.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The task is local Pandas or Dask computation.

skill_source_pins.name: qdrant-performance-optimization
skill_source_pins.description: Tune Qdrant indexing and search performance.
skill_source_pins.use_when: Vector-search latency or throughput is the explicit bottleneck.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The system is a Pandas/Dask batch pipeline.

skill_source_pins.name: qdrant-search-quality
skill_source_pins.description: Evaluate Qdrant search quality, filtering, and ranking behavior.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The task concerns data-frame resampling or parallel partitions.

skill_source_pins.name: temporal-python-testing
skill_source_pins.description: Choose local integration, replay, and unit-test boundaries for Temporal Python workflows.
skill_source_pins.use_when: Temporal workflow testing is the explicit project.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The target is a data analysis Notebook or Dask partition plan.

skill_source_pins.name: grpo
skill_source_pins.description: Reason about GRPO trainer internals and algorithm-specific diagnostics.
skill_source_pins.use_when: The task is specifically a GRPO trainer or algorithm issue.
skill_source_pins.do_not_use_when: The task is Pandas, time-series detrending, Dask, or Notebook structure.

generation_rules.controlled_pair: Positive and Negative share every field except one context message; Positive lacks one necessary fact/procedure/resource and Negative supplies exactly it.
generation_rules.external_claim_rule: Project histories, Memory, internal Knowledge, and natural negatives are synthetic Team content. Do not claim that the synthetic project decisions are upstream repository facts.
